entries.en: Y'know, I'm starting to get used to these little meetings.
entries.ro: Știi, încep să mă obișnuiesc cu întâlnirile astea mici.

entries.en: I sense you have many questions. I may answer only one.
entries.ro: Simt că ai multe întrebări. Pot răspunde doar la una.

entries.en: [Sit] What is it you're teaching me?
[Sit] Who are you? And why do you keep disappearing?
entries.ro: [Așează-te] Cine ești? Și de ce tot dispari?

entries.en: [Sit] Do you know what's happening to me?
What is it you're teaching me?
I am preparing you so that when the time comes, you will make the right choice.
entries.ro: Te pregătesc ca, atunci când vine momentul, să alegi bine.

entries.en: Who are you? And why do you keep disappearing?
entries.ro: Cine ești? Și de ce tot dispari?

entries.en: You can only ask one question.
I don't want to talk right now. I-I have to think.
entries.en_m: I don't want to talk right now. I have to think.
entries.ro: Nu vreau să vorbesc acum. T-trebuie să mă gândesc.
entries.ro_m: Nu vreau să vorbesc acum. Trebuie să mă gândesc.

entries.en: Very well.
The last one?
Yes. It will cost however much you want.
How does free sound?
[Pay] Hope this'll do.
How does "free" sound?
Hope this'll do.
I will guide you through the meditation.
entries.ro: O să te ghidez prin meditație.

entries.en: I am listening.
There is not a soul on the earth who would wait for you as I have.
entries.ro: Nu e suflet pe pământ care să te fi așteptat cum te-am așteptat eu.

entries.en: [Stand] There he goes again.
Aaand he's gone. Least he left something.
entries.en_m: Aaand he is gone. At least he left something.
entries.ro: Și... a dispărut. Cel puțin a lăsat ceva.

entries.en: I already know what I want to ask.
entries.ro: Știu deja ce vreau să întreb.

entries.en: I already know what I want to ask.
entries.ro: Știu deja ce vreau să întreb.

entries.en: See that? There-- there was a Zen master here. Poof! Vanished like that.
entries.en_m: You see that? There was a Zen master here. And poof! He vanished like that.
entries.ro: Vezi? Acolo-- acolo a fost un maestru Zen. Puf! A dispărut așa.
entries.ro_m: Vezi? Acolo a fost un maestru Zen. Și puf! A dispărut așa.

entries.en: The fuck are you talking about?
Not my scene. Go and talk to... to Misty if it bothers you.
entries.ro: Nu-i treaba mea. Du-te și vorbește cu... cu Misty dacă te deranjează.

entries.en: I don't want to talk right now.
You know what's happening to me, don't you?
entries.ro: Știi ce mi se întâmplă, nu?

entries.en: You are dying. You have two souls within you – one wants to fight, the other is afraid.
entries.ro: Ești pe moarte. Ai două suflete în tine – unul vrea să lupte, celălalt se teme.

entries.en: Which one's mine?
Both.
Are you ready for the final meditation technique?
entries.ro: Ești gata pentru ultima tehnică de meditație?

entries.en: What choice? When?
Oh, right. One question.
You cannot climb on two separate trees at once.
entries.ro: Nu poți urca în doi copaci diferiți în același timp.

entries.en: Are you fucking serious?
Cursing also cleanses the soul.
Yeah, good idea.
Fuck, I feel like a dog's shit.
entries.ro: Futu-i, mă simt ca un căcat de câine.

entries.en: He taught me how to meditate. It was kinda weird.
entries.ro: M-a învățat să meditez. A fost cam ciudat.
